details: prepare reads catalog.resolve and d1.event using scope+event_id, rejects terminal authority or unapproved fact/template/reference. Calls existing F129 materializer/qualification and existing locale renderer through f129.materialize, not new renderer/research engine. PRODUCT_INFO/PRESENTATION only in V1; event must be informational HUMAN_QUESTION, INTEREST routed to handoff, never continuing sale. Response data={request_id,material_ref,catalog_version}; material hash/locale/pins/approved facts persisted through materials.save adapter before dispatch.propose. Stable request same source bytes => REPLAY; changed input=>CONFLICT. No direct provider. Presentation attachment comes from approved artifact ref, no invented attachment or link. F129 unavailable=>DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, no replacement. prepare_initial(scope:InitialScope,request_id,candidate_ref,assessment_ref,catalog_version) preserves original initial research→qualification→materials→AUTO queue chain. Trusted refs resolve exact F129 candidate/assessment/binding/policy; f129.qualify invokes existing qualify_candidate. Only QUALIFIED_FOR_PREPARATION continues via f130.materialize_initial→materials.save→dispatch.propose(kind INITIAL_OUTREACH); NEEDS_REVIEW/NOT_QUALIFIED yields BLOCKED with verdict, no materials/send. Scope has five original F114 keys with thread_id=null for initial SEND; never fake provider thread. Initial operation does not require an inbound HUMAN_QUESTION. Product question prepare remains as above.
